description: This file defines a utility enum 'CameraAuthorization' that manages camera access authorization status, providing an asynchronous method to check authorization for a specified media type.

classes.name: CameraAuthorization
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods for camera authorization status management.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if access to a specified media type (e.g., video) is authorized, requesting access if undetermined.
